title: Fibrant simplicial groupoids model all spaces
statement: Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use coherent nerves, locally Kan simplicial categories, and Dwyer–Kan equivalences as in [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. A simplicial groupoid is a simplicial object in ordinary groupoids with constant set of objects; its arrows have strict degreewise inverses compatible with simplicial operators. It is fibrant when every simplicial mapping set is a Kan complex. Every small space $X$ admits a small fibrant simplicial groupoid $G$ and an equivalence $N_{\mathrm{hc}}G\simeq X$.
